page.layout: One printed page, left page of the book. Running text at the top, paragraph continues from the previous page. Below it a centred italic title in three lines. Under the title, two parallel columns of a table: left column Martius (days 1-31), right column Aprilis (days 1-30), each with its Aureus numerus. Catchword at the bottom right. Page number and running head at the top.

main_text.p: in 23 Martij, fuit inchoata. Quia vero Pascha celebrari solet mense Martio & Aprili, satis est ut aureū numerū in hisce duobus mensib. adscribamus, & quę si-tum tepore concilij Nicæni habuerit, consideremus.

head.i: Tabella Paschalis, ostendens si um aurei numeri calendario Romano impressi a Patribus Græcis & concilio Nicæno.

page.notes: Printing error left as printed: "tepore" for tempore. Uncertain readings: "si um" in the title (probably a broken word, perhaps sinum), "impressi" in the title, and "aureū" (macron read from scan). Long s written as plain s. Small mark near Aprilis 23 / Martius 26 is a stain, not printed. The numbers "2 3" at the start may be one number, 23, as read.
